title: OpenAI用1年时间证明，你并不用为AI换浏览器
content: OpenAI shut down its AI-native browser Atlas in August 2026 after just 292 days, joining a wave of failed AI browser ventures including Arc, Sidekick, and The Browser Company. Despite initial hype as a "Chrome killer," Atlas never expanded beyond macOS and attracted minimal users. Established browsers like Chrome retained two-thirds global market share throughout. Giants like Google and Microsoft quickly integrated AI features directly into existing browsers, removing any competitive window. The article concludes AI works better as a browser feature than a standalone product—users need not switch browsers for AI capabilities, just install plugins.

title: 张一鸣为什么反对蒸馏？
content: ByteDance founder Zhang Yimin opposes model distillation—a technique where smaller models learn from larger ones—preferring independent development despite higher costs and risks. At a July internal meeting, he directed Seed team to build foundational capabilities through pre-training, data systems, and engineering rather than leveraging external models. This reflects ByteDance's platform-native philosophy of controlling critical variables internally. The company is now pursuing large-scale model training, integrating resources from Volcano Engine, Doubao, and Feishu while tightening compliance around API usage. This strategic divergence highlights deepening route differentiation among Chinese AI firms beyond mere technical methods.

title: 21世纪最赚钱的技能是什么？不是 AI
content: Understanding human psychology is the most timeless and profitable meta-skill. The article identifies three core human anxieties that capture attention: survival (safety and problem-solving), identity (belonging and status), and self-actualization (meaning and growth). The author outlines five practical psychological levers: naming threats, mirroring identity, using exclusivity, painting transformation visions, and offering tiny first steps. Mastery of persuasion amplifies all other skills, since humans ultimately control resources and opportunities.

title: 做了一款终端优先的 AI 编程环境 Termio.sh, 比 Ghostty/ iTem2 / cmux 好用
content: Termio is a terminal-first AI development environment (ADE) for Mac and iOS, built with the libghostty kernel. It replaces traditional IDEs by optimizing for AI agent workflows, featuring project/session management, file trees, and diff views alongside terminal output. The iOS version enables mobile AI programming. The tool emphasizes performance, visual design, and seamless context provision to coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.

title: 一个哈萨克斯坦女研究生写了段脚本，190亿美元学术帝国被判了"死缓"，现在她又放出了AI | 原文
content: Kazakhstani graduate student Alexandra Elbakyan created Sci-Hub in 2011, a website offering free access to 88 million academic papers and disrupting the $19 billion scholarly publishing industry. After facing a $20 million court judgment, she has now released an AI tool. Her fifteen-year campaign against paywalled research continues, with the site still operational despite legal challenges.
